default_window_parameters.task_ordering: task_time ascending, stable tie-break by task_id

field_definitions.future_holdout_after_origin: The next task-time ordered certified task window after the origin, used only after selection for scoring.
field_definitions.future_holdout_size: The number of post-origin certified tasks used as the pseudo-future target for a window.
field_definitions.history_pool_before_origin: All eligible certified Sphinx tasks whose task ordering position is before the origin.
field_definitions.origin_stride: The number of certified task positions between consecutive origins.
field_definitions.selected_benchmark_from_history: A selector/compiler-chosen subset of history_pool_before_origin; the future holdout is not an input.
field_definitions.selected_benchmark_size: The number of history-pool tasks the future preregistered selector may choose for a window.

metric_formulas.mae_across_origins: Mean pass_rate_prediction_error over preregistered origins and Agents with complete selected/future outcome joins.
metric_formulas.pass_rate_prediction_error: For origin o and Agent a: abs(mean(score[a,t] for t in selected_benchmark_from_history[o]) - mean(score[a,t] for t in future_holdout_after_origin[o])).
metric_formulas.tuning_uplift_prediction_error: For later paid tuning only: abs((mean(after-before on selected_benchmark_from_history[o])) - (mean(after-before on future_holdout_after_origin[o]))).

no_paid_boundary: This protocol artifact authorizes no paid Agent cells, paid LLM calls, tuner calls, baseline discovery, or before/after tuning experiments.

score_join_rules.baseline_discovery: After selection is frozen, join Agent outcomes for selected benchmark tasks and future holdout tasks under the same verifier policy.
score_join_rules.failure_policy: Timeout, harness error, invalid output, and no meaningful change remain failed user-visible attempts unless the next preregistration explicitly narrows a scoreable denominator.
score_join_rules.hidden_oracle_boundary: Private oracle material is injected only in verifier workspaces, never into selector inputs or solver workspaces.
score_join_rules.reuse_policy: A task-Agent result may be reused across windows only after it has been legitimately run for a previous selected or future set; future holdout identity cannot be used to choose earlier selected tasks.

selector_leakage_rules.selected_task_constraint: selected_benchmark_from_history must be a subset of history_pool_before_origin and must not be picked from post-origin tasks.
selector_inputs_allowed: history_pool_before_origin task statements and allowed context when the next runbook preregisters those fields
selector_inputs_forbidden: verifier-only evidence beyond sanitized certification status needed to establish eligibility

supersedes.reason: The earlier feasibility artifact used train/selected/future as three disjoint segments and carried selected-only baseline cell accounting.
